limits: Small synthetic case set, live DeepSeek calls and fake Discord/database destinations; not a production accuracy estimate.
The reported production self-confession wording was not reproduced exactly in the controlled replay. Missing tag identity was reproduced in cold-cache/current/reply cases.

The semantic judge is imperfect: one baseline judgment erroneously accepts an unknown-name reply and another mischaracterizes correct bot self-identification. Required-name checks independently reject those target-lookup failures. No original judgment was overwritten.

An auxiliary research smoke passed 2/2 deterministic checks but 1/2 model judgments. Actual retrieval confirms its claim that organizer docs were not inspected is true, contrary to the judge's first critical flag. The answer gives the correct direct-webhook setup but adds unnecessary uncertainty about unasked payload details. It is retained as a partial research result, not silently counted as a full pass. Research worker/source-reader/search implementations are unchanged.

Model-based reference interpretation can still be wrong; unknown-tag responses may expose technical wording and overstate prior participation. This patch establishes identity/provenance, not perfect social reasoning.
